info.name: ContentApiUserProperties
info.description: Content API responses to anonymous callers leave out user properties (owner, modUser, publishUser, lockedBy and their names), including those of content embedded in a Story Block; searches on them are refused, key/value field values are kept, and administrators still get them. The content type and content are created and deleted by this collection.
